actual_schema.field_types: First observed record all scalar strings, text string, metadata dictionary; not universal schema proof.

boundedness_basis: First shard247.3MB compressed is observed. CommonPile card estimates ~1.5GB UTF8 across2 shards/106881rows, not a measured expansion bound. 2GBdecoded/100krecords/600sec are finite engineering ceilings; stop partial if any bound, no silent continuation/cap raise. Measure actual wall/RSS/SQLite footprint rather than extrapolate usable yield.
reader_and_source: O_RDONLY|NOFOLLOW regular exact-path before/FD/during/after stat matching independent full-file receipt; no source mutation/new request/global ledger.

Stream entire gzip with bounded zlib output and all member CRC/EOF/trailing-data checks. Hash every compressed input byte once, require exact publisher byte/SHA256 at full completion; do not materialize whole expanded source.

Physical JSONL line offsets/length/ordinal/SHA256 retained. Decode strictUTF8 and one dictionary per physical line. Oversized lines consumed/hash-held in fixed chunks within total decoded limit without parsing/reconstructing; terminal partial if budget hits mid-line.

Unknown schema/types/missing or unexpected keys, malformed timestamps and URL/family anomalies recorded as explicit holds with bounded exceptions/counts/ordered digests and original raw-line locator; no skipped records or assumption all records share first schema.
compact_storage: SQLite unique source ordinal; raw decompressed line offset/bytes/SHA256, textSHA256/UTF8bytes/chars if parsed, id/source/added/created, all observed rawmetadata fields or explicit overflow hold/hash/locator. No duplicate fulltext or original HTML (not present here).

Store exact source URL/id and book_url separately. Candidate book root derives only explicit host+leading bookslug from observed native PressBooks URL pattern, flagged derivation with source URL retained; book_url may be a frontmatter path, not canonical book homepage. Missing/conflicting or unknown URL patterns remain family-unresolved.

Metadata license rawstring and explicit observed licenseURL/version are evidence tags, not rights approval. Do not infer underlying source content rights from CommonPile package license. Distinguish BY/SA/NC/ND/public-domain/unknown exactly; no relabeling.

Book-title/author/institution/subject are captured metadata, not original-English or authorship verification. Identify repeated IDs/URLs/text hashes and shared book roots; retain all source occurrences, no canonical selection/admission during inventory.
All text lengths are bytes/chars; no tokens, language quality or usable counts.
family_and_review: Whole book/root/version page ancestry is the sampling/leakage unit; cross-source ancestry includes underlying OpenStax/Wikimedia/PG/LibreTexts/book adaptations, not automatically a new independent provenance group.

The first biased record is a nursing OER catalog with pipe/table-like text and __unknown__ URL path; this requires actual layout/coherence/source-component review, not a whole-source rejection or nursing-fact clearance.

Freeze full complete frame before uniform whole-unit and token-weighted later sampling; no firstrecord acceptance or extrapolation. Missing media/table/headings/quotation context and original HTML absence remain explicit extraction-fidelity risks.
Any later body selection must preserve complete native chapter/wholeunit context and wholebook family reservation; inventory alone cannot establish complete books.
